title: Layer 3 round 2 major QE: two round-1 falsifiers do not falsify — the glued-mark mutant survives the generic branch (milestone spaced-mark masks it), and machine report.degraded is pinned single-kind where the criterion quantifies per registered kind

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff0d3a3f: both named round-1 mutants now die — the glued-mark assertion moved from the whole segment onto the work-item field (the milestone field's own correctly-spaced mark was satisfying the containment check and masking a glued mark on the generic branch; the field-scoped assert plus a no-glue negative kills it), and machine_form_reports_the_degraded_kind loops both registered kinds by exact match, so a hardcoded-kind mutant dies on the arm whose fixture kind differs.
